text:
releasebot: New deploy queued: hotfix/kv-ttl-race -> canary. Change window 02:50-03:20 UTC. Reason: elevated embed 503s on heavy traffic. pinging @oncall SRE.

sarah: oncall here. quick ask — can we fast-track to 25% if smoke checks pass for 3mins? need to reduce customer impact ASAP. :ambulance:

lee: engineering +1. Patch is tiny: ttl + mutex around cache set. Image must be pinned to sha: f1e2d3c4. No DB migrations.

sre_kim: I'll stand by. Set immediate abort conditions: error-rate > 0.8% or tail latency p99 > 250ms for two consecutive minutes. Also isolate EU traffic from the rollout until we verify.

sarah: ops checklist snippet:```bash
# run canary
deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:f1e2d3c4
# health probes
curl -f https://svc.internal/health || exit 1
# monitors
alerts set embeddings-503 >0.5% --pager
```

opsbot: preflight: image exists, infra quotas ok, cluster disk < 70%, no blocked migrations, build artifact verified by buildbot. All clear.

buildbot: artifact scan: no critical findings. SBOM attached.

lee: approving expedited flow from eng side. If canary is green for 3m, we do phased fastcut to 25% then 50%. Keep rollback object handy.

sarah: approved as release lead. @releasebot please proceed on green.

releasebot: Starting canary deploy to 2 hosts (sha f1e2d3c4). Notifying #incidents and opening ephemeral channel.

sre_kim: watching metrics. will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

opsbot: canary minute 1: errors 0.6%, p99 140ms. minute 2: errors 0.3%, p99 130ms. minute 3: errors 0.2%, p99 135ms. Burn-in: PASSED.

sarah: initiating fastcut phase 1 -> 25% traffic. Pin applied.

opsbot: post-fastcut checks: 1m: errors 0.25%, p99 145ms. 3m: errors 0.2%, p99 150ms. No paging.

lee: rolling to 50% now. Keeping EU siloed until final sign-off.

sre_kim: EU will remain on stable until I give green. Observability shows small spike but within thresholds.

opsbot: 50% rollout complete. Monitoring 10m window.

sarah: created short release note: "hotfix: fix race in kv cache -> resolves intermittent 503s under embed load. pinned image f1e2d3c4." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/1724689999-kv-hotfix

lee: if stable after monitoring window, we'll merge into release train and tag.

releasebot: Rollout holding for 10m observation. Ephemeral channel will close after green.

sre_kim: If any alert fires I will initiate rollback to prev-sha with deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-88aa. Otherwise green in 10m.

opsbot: final check at +10m: errors 0.18%, p99 148ms. No alerts.

sarah: thanks all — closing ephemeral channel in 5. Will file postmortem note if anything else crops up. :white_check_mark:
